fields.name: Vrajamohana (disciple of Rasikānanda)
fields.notes:
He was a disciple of Rasikānanda prabhu (Rasikamaṅgala Paścima 14.112, 128, 149, 150, 152).

(12-11-2026: the Vaiṣṇava poet Vrajamohana, born 1875, was in this record too; now his own record, «Vrajamohana (poet, born 1875)».)

He was a Vaiṣṇava poet (Baṅgīya Sāhitya Sevaka).

(12-11-2026: split from #1735 Vrajamohana, the disciple of Rasikānanda, who lived about 1600.)
